notes.title: 50% discount and new Update!
notes.content:
Hello, we have good news!

We've just released "Community Stats" update and made a small infographic with various interesting facts that have been collected since the release:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38057015/e076f1fd82a408cbcaad98e636669d5b8f2d452f.jpg[/img]

As you might have guessed, the update adds new vidgets to the Medals and Archives menus that allow you to compare your progress with other players in the community, including:

[list]
[*] How many players have also unlocked a medal:
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38057015/ff198201671872dcbee656c7dff1516bc6867d16.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] How many players, like you, have treated or refused a patient on their first playthrough.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38057015/a855c6316483230a1d14b19a727f56ed27a62aa1.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] How many players have also discovered a hero's Fate.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38057015/5fe160cbc1f5a7db38df5f0ac257dcff1e3b19f4.jpg[/img]

In addition, we've added pop-up hints for some UI elements, and also fixed inconveniences when playing on widescreen monitors.

Small bugfixes are also included.

To celebrate this event, we have set a 50% discount until April 20th.

Play and discover the secrets of Field Hospital!

notes.title: Simplified Chinese Localization Beta starts today!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38057015/7ec9b6b6613ecaca8b47c252d1c8ef5f79161c76.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone!

We are happy to announce that the Simplified Chinese Localization Beta starts today!

If you’ve signed up for beta via Google Form check your email for Steam Key and activate it. 

After activation (or if you have the game already) follow this simple steps:
[olist]
[*] Go to your [b]Steam Library[/b]
[*] Right-click on [b]Field Hospital: Dr. Taylor's Story[/b] and select [b]Properties[/b].
[*] Go to the tab marked [b]Betas[/b].
[*] In the drop-down box, select [b]localization-beta[/b].
[*] Wait for the game to finish updating, you should see the branch name listed after the game name.
[*] In the game you may need to switch language to Simplified Chinese. Click on the [b]Settings [/b]and then click on the [b]Language [/b]field to switch between languages. [b]Apply [/b]your changes.
[*] You are ready to play :)
[/olist]

Use the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1315120/discussions/2]Steam Forum[/url] to leave your feedback.

You may leave your feedback on localization in the [b]Localization Beta[/b] forum. Here are things to look at:
[list]
[*] [b]Localization of texts and terms[/b]. You may switch between languages at any time using the Settings menu to check English text for comparison.
[*] [b]Indents and their absence[/b]. 
[*] [b]Commas and dots at the beginning of the line[/b]. We are still looking for a solution but it requires some time. If you encounter commas or dots at the beginning of the line please take a screenshot and send us via Steam Forum.
[*] [b]Fonts size and alignment[/b]. If it’s easy to read and understand.
[*] [b]Anything you think is important to share[/b].
[/list]

If you’ve encountered a bug or any technical difficulties leave your report in the [b]Bug Reports and Technical Issues[/b] forum. If you want to share your feedback on the game itself or story feel free to use the general discussions forum. 

If you have any questions you may ask them right in the comments below.

Cheers!

tags.feature: We are happy to announce that the Simplified Chinese Localization Beta starts today!

notes.title: Field Hospital now supports macOS!
notes.content:
Now the bureaucratic detective game Field Hospital: Dr. Taylor's Story is also available on Apple's OS. We invite macOS users to plunge into an alternative history and take responsibility for deciding who to treat and whom to refuse.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38057015/5396a2022a860ad2ef8d3b4501aabafcb323d68a.jpg[/img]

In addition, the new patch 1.06 introduces additional changes. Here's a small list:
[list]
[*] Fixed the bug with the volume of the stamp click sound.
[*] Music has been adjusted: now in the menu and in calm episodes you won't hear shouts and shots.
[*] Fixed the bug with the signature sound: now it is played at the beginning of the signing, and not at the end.
[*] Fixed the bug with the sequence of stamp animations.
[*] Now the information about the number of beds and requests on the Dr. Taylor's first day is displayed even when skipping tutorial.
[/list]

As always, we are waiting for your feedback and wishes!

notes.title: Resolution bug fixed in Patch 1.05
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We've just released Patch 1.05. 

The main fix relates to different resolution issues. Now you can play Field Hospital on any display.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38057015/dea9591553c9119bf4a09d6b79a20310a951e175.jpg[/img]

Other fixes are:
- Medals are counted even without internet connection.
- Cursor bar fixed in menus.
- Autofocus on input field at the beginning.
- Return to main menu from medals window by pressing ESC.
- Several small text edits.

Share your impressions of the game and wishes for improving it!

Good luck in the new year!

notes.title: Skip Tutorial feature in Patch 1.04
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We've just released Patch 1.04. The most prominent feature it brings is the dialogue window at your second-third playthrough that let you skip tutorial dialogues. It also fixes some bugs like wrong player name description.

Also starting from this patch we are testing global statistics feature.

Thanks for playing and stay safe!

notes.title: Progress Saving in Patch 1.03!
notes.content:
We've added Progress Saving with Patch 1.03 that was demanded by many of our players.

Now at every chapter's start you may notice this indicator:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38057015/ac2de456d10f91c9c4ceedecc5b5ffc1f12b27dd.png[/img]

It means your progress has been saved! You may leave the game and return to it later.

The next patches will be dedicated to skipping Tutorial dialogues at game start and adding global statistics. Stay tuned for more!

Also we've added new forum for you to share your technical issues and bugs you've encountered in the game. Feel free to post them! We want to make your game experience as smooth as possible.

Good luck, Doctors!

tags.feature: We've added Progress Saving with Patch 1.03 that was demanded by many of our players.

notes.title: Hot fix patch 1.02 is here!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Here is a list of few quick fixes we've made today:

[olist]
[*] Indicator of new medals in Main Menu. Now you can keep track on unlocked medals and see if something new is unlocked!
[*] Correct work of default sound settings. We've noticed the game is mute at the first start. Now it is fixed. Turn music on! It's really moody.
[*] Minor corrections in patients descriptions.
[*] Minor animations and transitions bugs fixes.
[/olist]

If you'd like to share your opinion on the game we encourage you to leave a review or write it down in comments. 

Hope you're enjoying it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38057015/754cebc0d05a40cd3f401ad92b09b74efac4141b.png[/img]
